capabilities: Generate Q&A and cloze cards from note rules
Schedule reviews with FSRS and four grades
Browse, search and batch-edit cards in a table
Import Anki .apkg decks and build exam plans
disambiguation: Not a generator of mock or placeholder cards; it is a full spaced-repetition system with FSRS scheduling.
extras: README is bilingual (English and Chinese) and the settings tab switches language automatically. All data stays local with no network requests; no AI model is bundled, external tools push cards in via JSON. The README notes a newly listed plugin may need an Obsidian restart before it appears in the community list.
problem: Reviewing notes with spaced repetition usually means copying content into Anki or editing the notes themselves to add card markup.

relations.evidence: Anki import (.apkg): basic, cloze and image-occlusion notes plus their media
links to Browse and Review the way the True Recall dashboard does

summary: Spaced-repetition flashcard system that builds Q&A, cloze and image-occlusion cards from notes and stores them as JSON in a separate folder.
